rules.title: Security Deposit Law
rules.requirement: Landlords can charge at most one and a half months' rent as a security deposit, and any yearly increase in the deposit is capped at 10% of the current deposit amount. Deposits must be held in an interest-bearing account and returned with accrued interest.
rules.key_value: 1.5 months' rent max; 10% max annual increase
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to most residential rental properties including mobile homes; owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt unless the tenant requests coverage.
rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, unless tenant requests application of the law 30 days after written request.
rules.quoted_span:
The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than 
one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ). It can be less. Any additional 
yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.

rules.title: Security Deposit Law - deposit holding, investment, and transfer rules
rules.requirement: Security deposit money remains the tenant's property and must be held in trust, not commingled with the landlord's own funds. Landlords with 10 or fewer units must deposit the money in an interest-bearing account at a New Jersey bank or savings and loan; landlords with 10 or more units may also use a money market fund. If the property is sold, the new owner must obtain and continue to hold the deposit plus accrued interest, and remains responsible for returning it with interest.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords holding security deposits, with different investment options depending on whether they hold money for 10 or fewer, or 10 or more, units; does not apply to seasonal use or rental (125 days or less).
rules.exemptions: Seasonal use or rental of not more than 125 consecutive days by a person with a permanent residence elsewhere (not farm worker housing).
rules.quoted_span:
A landlord or designee who receives security deposit money for ten or less units must 
deposit that money in an insured bank or savings and loan association located in New Jersey in an 
interest-bearing account at the current interest rate at the time of deposit.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the rental is seasonal use (125 days or less)
